before.prose: Stage 2 (owner decision on #143, 2026-10-24, option (a)): the skeleton's open premise STMT-GOD-HAS-CLASSICAL-DIVINE-ATTRIBUTES, derived. The definitional bridge (Dei Filius ch. 1) lists nine attributes. Four are derived for whatever is God through its being maximal in being: one, simple, perfect, supremely good (CATHOLICISM-STAGE2-GOD-IS-ONE, -SIMPLE, -PERFECT, -SUPREMELY-GOOD, imported). The other five (infinite, immutable, eternal, intellect, will) are open premises, each supported by Dei Filius ch. 1, until their groups (ST I qq.7, 9, 10, 14, 19) are derived.

before.prose: The owner's stage-2 reading of Dei Filius ch. 1. Signature.HasClassicalAttributes is still a primitive field. ClassicalAttributesSuffice is an explicit open, one-way premise from the nine predicates to that field, not a definitional equality or an eliminator recovering all nine predicates from it. GodHasClassicalAttributes means ∀ g, σ.IsGod g → σ.HasClassicalAttributes g. No changed proof, closed frontier, or truth of the bridge is claimed by adding this mapping.

Re-read materialized VATICAN-I-DEI-FILIUS-CH1, DS 3001–3002. The council confesses an existing God and attributes; it does not universally quantify arbitrary predicates into a skeleton field. Corrected explanatory bridge wording without revising the source-bound statement or adding a claim.

before.prose: The council's confession of God's attributes (DS 3001): one, true, living, creator and lord, almighty, eternal, immense, incomprehensible, infinite in intellect, will and every perfection; one singular, altogether simple and unchangeable spiritual substance; really distinct from the world; most blessed; exalted above all. With 'bonitate sua' (DS 3002) for goodness. Kept as prose. It is the list that the definitional bridge STMT-CLASSICAL-ATTRIBUTES-SUFFICE abbreviates (owner decision on #143, 2026-10-24) and supports the five attributes not yet derived. As in the root (A), it states what the Church teaches; it is not used as a premise of the derivations.

limits: Exactly this result and its six declared inference steps, their 21 statements, 25 definitions, 14 directly linked disambiguations, one argument and one clarified source claim. Imported results are reused evidence; they are not all migrated to complete-expression contracts.
15 hypothesis occurrences reported used; syntactic use is not a necessity proof. Full excluded middle may be stronger than identity decidability; no weaker result is certified here.
Being is inhabited by Signature.jesus. IsGod need not be inhabited. The conclusion is pointwise, so empty-IsGod vacuity is legitimate and explicitly tested.

The Unit positive setting realizes all nonlogical premises with a God witness, conditional on the same explicit excluded-middle hypothesis. It supplies no metaphysical applicability or independent proof of that logical floor.

Primitive Infinite, Immutable, Eternal, HasIntellect and HasWill parameters are not automatically expanded into their intended philosophical accounts. Complete-expression checks detect context/dependency changes, not semantic adequacy.
Structure extraction is bounded and preserves library boundaries. It does not recursively enumerate every library law or turn unknown expressions into independent atoms.
